name: The Grand Azure Resort & Spa
tagline: Sanctuary of Coastal Elegance & Unrivaled Luxury
description: Perched on dramatic oceanfront cliffs overlooking Azure Bay, The Grand Azure Resort & Spa is a five-star Forbes Travel Guide certified luxury sanctuary. Features 220 guest accommodations including cliffside ocean villas, three world-class restaurants, a 25,000 sq ft holistic spa, cliffside infinity pools, private yacht marina, and bespoke 24/7 concierge services.
